heuristics.name: salient/sophisticated vocabulary
heuristics.description: pick the most distinctive or exam-worthy word, or the one that plausibly fits a richer context (e.g. dormant, brackish, nomadic, prolific)

heuristics.name: two-blank coherence/contrast
heuristics.description: for paired blanks prefer pairs with a clean contrast or tight logical relation (austere...whimsy, impersonal...intimate, popular...unworkable)

notes: No option could be rejected with certainty without the stem; all reject_certain=false.
